main_text.head: SECT. XII. CAP. II.
main_text.l: 1. Non præsumenda est mutatio statutorum, sed
2. Quid si statuta quidem condita, verum usu
3. An statutum obtineat, si decennium interlabatur?
4. Abolentur statuta desuetudine, vel usu contrario.
5. Quod nam tempus ad desuetudinem requiratur?
6. An ad contrarium usum introducendum sufficiat unus actus?
8. An si civitas armis sit subacta?
9. An Revocatis statutis, reformationes censeantur revocatæ?
10. An revocatis statutis, censeantur ante gesta reo cata?
11. An allegans statuta abolita incidat in crimen falsi?

page.notes: Scan has a Google watermark at the lower right edge, not printed text, and was left out. The word "tol-" at the end of entry 7 and "sed" of entry 1 are as printed. Some words in entries 2 and 10 are faint, but the readings given are the most likely ones: "reo cata" in entry 10 may be a printing error for "rea cata".
